values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.'

summary: Confirmed (from DWR's statewide WMA camping page; Thompson's own page only links it) no hookups, no water/dump/restrooms, and the 14-night limit with the $10 camping authorization. Not stated: season, the $4 access-permit price (inherited all-in rate and AWH-confirmed note left as they are), anything specific to the Lower Ted Lake parking area. OSM maps no water within 600 m of the pin, consistent with the AWH note 'not on the lake' and the 300-ft lake setback.
